blender: 5.2.1 LTS, headless build of the same scene script (Blender MCP not connected)
artwork: Threshold white screenshot lettering at 170; trace eight connected shapes and holes with OpenCV at 0.65px contour tolerance; shallow extrusions in graphite enamel for the light LCD. Screenshot background discarded.

delivery.color: RGB555-style quantization; binary alpha; nearest-neighbour display
delivery.playback: Once per selection, indefinite final hold; final frame immediately for reduced motion
delivery.motion: Pixel chevron writes HACK left-to-right, turns downward, writes LDN right-to-left, drops to a third row and dashes left-to-right through 25 (each digit pops in like the letters) and off screen, then slides back in from the left and rotates into its final position. No cube.

digits: 25 drawn by scripts/blender/build-hack-ldn-2025-digits.py at the traced lettering's 330px cap height, 73px stems and 62px bars; extruded with the same graphite enamel.
